lines.name: l1
lines.text: When Jericho fell, one family walked out alive. Her name was Rahab. She lived in Jericho's wall. The Bible calls her a prostitute. Two spies came from God's people, Israel.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: She hid them, because she believed in their God. They told her: hang a red cord in your window, and your family will be safe.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: Israel marched. The people shouted. And "the wall fell down flat". Rahab and her family were spared. The cord was the sign. Trusting the promise saved her. A book of the Bible, Hebrews, says it in two words: "By faith".

lines.name: l4
lines.text: She is named in the family line of Jesus, God's Son, who "taketh away the sin of the world".

lines.name: l5
lines.text: Rahab could not stop a wall. She tied one cord to a promise. Tie your trust to Jesus, and bring everyone you love inside.
